audience: email and SMS marketers who manage contacts and campaigns in Vision6

useCases.title: Compare the results of your last campaigns
useCases.text: The AI lists send reports with sent, opened, unique clicks, bounces and unsubscribes, and compares campaigns by open rate. It can read one report with per-link clicks.

useCases.title: See who opened a message
useCases.text: The AI lists the contacts one message was sent to, with send time and first and last open time, so you see who opened it.

useCases.title: List the contacts that joined a list
useCases.text: The AI lists the contacts of a list filtered by creation time, email or a custom field, with status and fields. It reads the list's fields first.

useCases.title: Add, update or unsubscribe contacts
useCases.text: The AI adds one contact or up to 200 at once to a list, or changes a contact's fields or subscription status. This may trigger the list's automations.

useCases.title: Send a transactional email or SMS
useCases.text: The AI sends a transactional email or SMS to up to 100 recipients right away, and uses sending credits. It cannot be recalled.
